acceptNote: 0.7857 is the calibrated value of raw confidence 0.70, the operating point chosen from the measured table: 92.3% precision at 64.7% corrected recall, and 0.67 spurious boxes per page known to contain no lyrics. Expressed as a calibrated threshold rather than a raw one because the design forbids deciding on raw confidence; the two are interchangeable here only because the calibration is monotone by construction. Dynamic has no threshold and stays review-only: the rareNum core remains the sole automatic authority on dynamics.

Lyrics.note: Raw confidence is a mean pixel probability and may never decide anything. These bins map it to an estimated probability that the box is a real lyric, fitted by pool-adjacent-violators to 145 human judgements. The first two bands were pooled because the observed rates were non-monotone (0.600 then 0.571), which is sampling noise rather than a real inversion.

falsePositive.note: String quartet pages. Lyrics are absent by construction, so every Lyrics box is a false positive and needs no adjudication.

precision.note: Unmatched boxes at or above 0.5 only. Matched boxes are true by construction and are not sampled.

recall.note: Score-disjoint sample; recall is trustworthy because a box exists only where OCR read text and it matched the score's own MusicXML.

geometry.note: For surfacing overlaps as review work, not for deciding them. With one detector and one automatic class, a conflict can only be Lyrics against Dynamic, and Dynamic can never win because it has no threshold -- so every such overlap is review work whatever these numbers are.

groundTruthCaveat: The vocal corpus understates lyric coverage by roughly half: 545 OCR-confirmed against an estimated 1143 real. Any future measurement against it inherits that, including any judgement of a retrained detector.

metrics.note: Corrected recall extrapolates each band's measured precision to every unmatched box in it -- a modelling assumption, not a measurement, with wide per-band intervals. Only boxes at or above 0.5 were sampled, so the true lyric total is a lower bound and corrected recall an upper bound.

minimumWinnerMarginNote: No margin is meaningful with one automatic class: nothing it could out-score is ever eligible to win. Recorded as zero rather than omitted so a reader can see it was considered.
note: A single-detector policy, selected by name. It is not a fallback for fusion-v1: invariant 8 requires that a failure of either detector fails a fusion request rather than degrading to this.
